mechanism: Estradiol inhibits prednisone metabolism via CYP3A4 inhibition, increasing corticosteroid exposure and adverse effects; prednisone may enhance estradiol side effects including thromboembolism risk.
action: Monitor for increased corticosteroid adverse effects (hyperglycemia, hypertension, immunosuppression); consider prednisone dose reduction or increased monitoring; evaluate thromboembolism risk in patients on estradiol-containing formulations.
